name: @isox-sh/core
description: Run existing scripts with core:run-command. Included with the Isox CLI; also provides the workspace and plugin APIs.

name: @isox-sh/js
description: Build TypeScript packages with js:tsc, watch for changes, and scaffold new libraries.

name: @isox-sh/rspack
description: Bundle projects with rspack:build and run a local development server with rspack:serve.

name: @isox-sh/eslint
description: Lint projects with eslint:lint and apply ESLint fixes through your project targets.

name: @isox-sh/playwright
description: Run Playwright tests and split suites across CI jobs with playwright:test.

name: @isox-sh/vitest
description: Run project test suites with vitest:test and generate Vitest configuration.

name: @isox-sh/semver
description: Version packages from conventional commits, write changelogs, and coordinate publishing hooks.

name: @isox-sh/nx
description: Use supported Nx 23 executors while migrating. Keep the corresponding Nx executor packages installed.

name: @isox-sh/e2e
description: Test your own plugins in temporary workspaces. A helper library for plugin authors, with no target executor.
